verdict.rationale: Airwallex's AgentOS toolkit lets AI agents act on account data and 'build cashflow reports,' implying some data-insight generation, but there is no evidence of a native, user-facing AI insights/suggestions feature surfaced inside the product UI itself — it's framed as a developer/agent toolkit rather than an end-user analytics experience. Missing for 10: evidence of in-product dashboards or proactive AI-generated recommendations for end users, independent corroboration of AgentOS producing actual insights.
